summary: Participants discuss design decisions such as including Delta mode, renaming the proposal to FastLanes, and adding Unified Transpose Layout, weighing performance and clarity. The consensus leans toward adopting Delta mode and using FastLanes terminology while deferring more complex layouts to future work. The proposal is that inline data takes precedence, with locator fields serving only provenance, and that the spec be clarified to prevent inconsistent results. The discussion proposes breaking backward compatibility to encrypt the whole page, updating the spec, and implementing the fix in version 1.19.0.
